T-014.Title: Viewer and edit-preview polish from the live smoke (2026-10-16)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: An open fullscreen viewer follows a theme switch: the clone is refreshed from the re-rendered block (diagram colours, table colours), keeping zoom/position where practical.

«Fit» scales a small diagram UP to the available viewer area (today fit is capped at 1:1, so a small chart stays tiny); the initial open of a small diagram also fits up; 1:1 still shows the natural size.

While a diagram's source is edited, its live preview no longer floats over the following blocks: it takes its own space under the source (in flow), so the next heading/block stays visible and nothing overlaps.

T-014.Notes: ZCode agent (worktree agent/c51-t14) implemented 2026-10-17; gates to be run by the orchestrator (agent has no shell). (1) Fit-up: blockViewer v3.0.0 computeFitScale drops the inherited 1:1 cap — min(availW/w, availH/h) clamped to [MIN_SCALE 0.05, MAX_SCALE 8]; the Fit button, the '0' key and the initial open share it, actualSize (1:1) is untouched, big diagrams scale down exactly as before (their min is already < 1). Tables that reach the viewer (need-gated: overflowing/tall) always fit < 1, so the cap removal is a no-op for them in practice. (2) Theme-follow: Muya#setOptions v1.7.0 dispatches muya-options-rerender after the needRender full re-render (the editor.vue watch(theme) path); the viewer subscribes, remembers the open source element + figure id (block-key ids survive snabbdom re-patches), and POLLS the live block every 100 ms (10 s budget): by source id first, then the figure id → div.ag-container-preview with svg/img content (tables: table.ag-paragraph) — the content check waits through the loading placeholder so the async mermaid insert / awaited vega embed is never cloned mid-flight — then refreshCloneFrom swaps the canvas clone IN PLACE (panzoom transform untouched → zoom and pan kept; dispatches muya-block-viewer-refreshed, logs [Muya][blockViewer][BLOCK_VIEWER_THEME_REFRESH kind blockKey]); close()/open() cancel the poll; a block deleted by the re-render keeps the last clone on timeout. (3) Edit preview in flow: the figure.ag-active.ag-container-block > div.ag-container-preview rule of muya assets/styles/index.css loses the MarkText float (position:absolute/top calc(100%+20px)/left 50%/translateX/z-index 10000) and becomes an in-flow framed panel below the source (margin-top 20px keeps the float's gap; same surface/hairline/shadow) — following blocks are pushed down, never covered; the rule stays unscoped so multiplemath edits in flow too, the html preview keeps its own display:none-while-active rule, tables have no preview, and all 32 per-theme overrides only re-declare box-shadow (verified; a regression test pins it). Tests: unit — block-viewer.test.js v2.2.0 (fit maths small/big/clamps + fitToScreen wiring; refresh: immediate re-clone + event, poll through the placeholder, figure-id fallback for a replaced element, direct refreshCloneFrom touches no panzoom method/transform, sanitized table refresh, closed no-op, timeout keeps the clone) and NEW edit-preview-flow.test.js v1.0.0 (CSS pins: no float declarations, framed panel kept, unscoped rule, html rule intact, no theme re-declares geometry). E2E — block-viewer.spec.ts v3.1.0 T-014 section (chromium + webkit-block-viewer): tiny 2-node diagram opens via Cmd/Ctrl+click at canvas scale > 1.2 and Fit holds it, 1:1 → scale 1 with the drawn box = viewBox size; theme switch paper → ink written straight into the preferences store (the same pref the title-bar toggle writes — the overlay covers the title bar) → the CLONE's mermaid node fill becomes the LIVE re-rendered figure's fill with the canvas scale unchanged; plain-click editing of a mermaid block and of a math block → computed position static and the following heading's top ≥ the preview's bottom. bootstrapWithMarkdown gained an extraPrefs param (backwards compatible). Red on main: the fit-maths unit cases (cap at 1), the refresh unit cases (no muya-options-rerender exists), the edit-preview-flow pins (absolute float present) and the three T-014 e2e cases fail; no pre-existing case touched. Graph M-012 summary + verification V-M-011 scenario-64, V-M-011 commands, V-M-012 BLOCK_VIEWER_THEME_REFRESH marker added. No locale strings. Gate round 2026-10-17 (same agent, worktree agent/c51-t14; fixes for the orchestrator gate): the two unit failures and the chromium e2e theme-follow failure were CODE bugs in the refresh (blockViewer v3.1.0) — (a) resolveLiveSource's by-id lookup could resolve the VIEWER'S OWN CLONE (cloneNode keeps the preview div id and the svg id is deliberately shared for mermaid's scoped styles), so after a re-render replaced the live element the poll re-cloned its own stale copy; id lookups now skip anything inside the overlay; (b) re-renders that replace the inner elements of an id-less figure never resolved — the figure ELEMENT captured at open is now an isConnected-checked fallback anchor; (c) chromium race: the mermaid pipeline re-inserts the byte-identical LAST-GOOD old-theme svg synchronously during the re-render (before the async re-draw), so the poll's first tick saw content present, cloned the old colours and stopped — the poll now gates on a changed-content token (outerHTML of the LIVE source only; the clone's serialization is never compared) and ends on the first real change; the two failing unit cases were correct as written and stay byte-identical. The in-flow e2e failure (both engines) was a TEST bug: muya's universal .ag-paragraph rule (getSelector adds it to every block element) keeps position:relative on the preview — relative is still IN FLOW; the float bug was absolute. The assertion now checks in-flow (not absolute/fixed) plus STRONGER geometry (preview top ≥ edited source bottom; next heading top ≥ preview bottom). block-viewer.test.js v2.3.0 adds three cases pinning the exclusion (viewBox fixture so a self-clone refresh is visible), the unchanged-content gate and the figure-element fallback; block-viewer.spec.ts v3.1.1; edit-preview-flow.test.js MODULE_MAP gained HERE/MUYA_CSS/THEMES_DIR (grace lint). No acceptance criterion was weakened.

T-010.Notes: ZCode agent (worktree agent/c51-t10) implemented 2026-10-16; gates to be run by the orchestrator (agent has no shell). Design notes: new src/muya/lib/parser/render/renderBlock/expandNeed.js (v1.0.0) holds the D-7 need rules — diagramNeedRule (laid out AND (preview taller than 600 px OR rendered ≥ 2 px narrower than natural; natural from SVG viewBox first, then a unitless/px width attribute — width="100%" is the CSS stretch and rejected — or, for plantuml, img.naturalWidth when complete)), tableNeedRule (wrapper scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1 OR table taller than 600 px) — plus the ag-expand-needed class toggle (log anchor [Muya][expandNeed][BLOCK_EXPAND_NEED blockKey needed], debug, flips only), syncExpandNeed (evaluate + keep ONE shared ResizeObserver in step across muya instances: observe new figures, unobserve disconnected ones) and releaseExpandNeedObservations (Muya.destroy drops only that container's figures). Guarded for jsdom (no ResizeObserver → render-time evaluation only). Wiring: every StateRender render path (render/partialRender/singleRender) runs syncExpandNeed after the diagram dispatch; mermaidPipeline insertSvg (first render, cache hit, keep-last-good) and every renderDiagram insert (re-resolved after the awaited vega embed; the error path clears the class) call updateFigureExpandNeed. The button vnode is UNCHANGED (renders on every viewable figure); CSS gates visibility: display:none without the class (no Tab stop — focus() is a no-op), flex with it, still none on figure.ag-active. Look = .ag-code-copy: 20 px square, 16 px glyph, absolute top/right 0.5em, border none, background transparent, radius 4, var(--iconColor), opacity 0 / 0.5 (figure hover) / 1 (button hover + :focus-visible); the T-006 44 px strips and body.compact-block-tools rules are REMOVED and the table tools bar keeps its original top:-22px band. Table placement (task offered two options; picked the margin band): the icon sits in that same band above the table's top-right corner (top:-22px, right:0) — geometrically disjoint from the header text and the last column's resize hit zone, and never co-visible with the tools bar (active vs not). The hover pencil moves to right:2.2em ONLY on figures that need the button. Click routing, viewer, keyboard guard and Cmd/Ctrl+click (any viewable block, class or not) unchanged. Tests: tests/renderer/muya/expand-need.test.js (pure rules incl. the 698/697 tolerance edge and 701/702 wrapper tolerance, viewBox priority over a wider width attr, percentage rejection, img naturalWidth, empty preview, not-laid-out 0×0, table DOM via stubbed scrollWidth/clientWidth/rects, class flip + log anchor + flip-only logging, sync without ResizeObserver, shared-observer observe/unobserve/callback/release) is new and fails on main (module absent); block-expand-button.test.js v1.3.0 keeps every render/click/keyboard/glyph/export case and replaces the 30 px/44 px CSS pins with the copy-icon pins (incl. the strip and compact rules ABSENT). E2e block-viewer.spec.ts v3.0.0: small mermaid + small table have no visible button (display none, offsetParent null, focus() no-op) yet Cmd/Ctrl+click still opens the viewer; a 14-node graph LR, a wide flowchart.js chain (st->w1(right)…), a 12-column table and a 30-row table DO get it (exactly 4 ag-expand-needed figures in the mixed fixture); opacity 0 → ≥ 0.4 on figure hover → 1 on button hover and on real-Tab :focus-visible; diagram button ≤ 22 px inside the figure rect; table button fully above the table (≤ 1 px), within 24 px of the figure's top-right, no intersection with the last th or its .ag-column-resizer, which still drags (wrapper scrolled right first, like table-layout.spec.ts); narrowing the viewport to 460 px scales a medium diagram and adds the button (the column is capped at --editorAreaWidth 750 px, so a fixed small viewport is the deterministic flip); Tab walks mermaid → flowchart → wide-table buttons, skipping the four hidden ones; the T-008 traffic-lights case and the viewer lifecycle cases now open via the needed button of the wide fixture. Red on main: expand-need.test.js fails to load; the new block-viewer.spec cases fail (need class/hidden-button assertions); the Cmd+click and viewer-lifecycle cases pass on main by design. No locale strings added. E2e closure 2026-10-16 (same agent, second pass): the two remaining e2e failures (Esc-restore on chromium+webkit; Tab-walk on chromium) shared one root cause — muya's keyup selection machinery ran on keyups targeted at the focused expand button; getCursorRange's needFix repair calls setCursorRange → Selection.addRange inside the contenteditable, and Chromium/WebKit then focus the editing host (Chromium fires no focus events and can land the move a frame later, so a poll saw the flowchart button once before the steal, the opacity check passed vacuously on the container — its computed opacity is also 1 — and the next Tab keydown hit the container where tabHandler trapped it); the cursor-diff branch could also partialRender, replacing the figure and detaching the focused button so the close() re-asserts no-opped on the captured element. Fixes: keyboard.js v1.4.0 guards keyup too (isExpandButtonEvent, shared with the T-006 keydown guard — keyups on the button never reach the selection machinery); blockViewer v2.0.2 re-asserts re-resolve the LIVE button from returnFocusFigureId. Unit tests added: the keyup-guard case in block-expand-button.test.js v1.4.0 (spies selection.getCursorRange; button keyups never call it, an editor keyup still does — fails without the guard) and the live-reassert case in block-viewer.test.js v2.1.0 (the figure's button is replaced inside the 0/50 ms window; the re-assert must focus the replacement — fails against the captured-element version). The two e2e cases were NOT weakened.
